view.world_units: 1 unit = 1 map tile (12 source px); x right, y up; origin = top-left corner of the current room; screen x right/y down

legend.unknown: ? unknown: outside the window, behind the HUD or a text box, or the screen is faded; never safe
legend.background: . visible background/no visible obstacle; not a collision guarantee
legend.solid: # visible solid-looking terrain (black areas of the picture, solid doors)
legend.platform: = visible floating platform (furniture and the like): solid
legend.interactable: + visible thing that reacts to a nail strike (door, jar, lever)
legend.scenery: : visible scenery, debris, water, a dead enemy, the player's own nail swing; no collision

text.content: Press [Z] to jump, press [X] to attack

rules: Explore: leave the room through an opening at one of its edges. No direction to an offscreen exit is supplied.
Walk left/right; jump height depends on how long jump is held. More abilities (dash, wall jump, double jump, spells) are found later in the game.
The nail strikes left/right, or up/down while up/down is held (down only in the air); a downward strike on spikes or an enemy bounces you up.
Doors and jars break when struck. Enemies and their projectiles hurt on touch. Spikes hurt and put you back on the last safe ground.
Screen x increases right and screen y increases down. Each action holds for the requested window of frames; the game pauses while the next action is chosen.

disclosure.visibility: label render of the scene with the game's camera and draw order; what is covered by terrain, shadow layers, the HUD or a text box is not reported
disclosure.geometry: terrain/door/hazard objects are the game's collision rectangles clipped to where their art is seen; sprites are their visible pixel bounds
disclosure.unsupported: texels below 0.9 alpha are treated as not drawn; pause menu and map screens are reported as unknown
disclosure.resolution: 40 px cells on a 960 x 523 screen
disclosure.debug: debug_observation.json / observations.jsonl hold global state; plumbing and evaluation only
